executionNotice: 以下是等价聚合逻辑的只读SQL示例，不在浏览器或服务器执行学生SQL。参数来自已保存的固定选项；示例省略输入校验、结果对象与最终六位舍入，实际由固定JS和Java计算器完成。

snippets.title: 先合计分子分母，再算率
snippets.code:
SELECT SUM(completed_count) AS numerator_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN :denominator = 'first_lesson_count' THEN first_lesson_count ELSE enrolled_count END) AS denominator_count,
 SUM(completed_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN :denominator = 'first_lesson_count' THEN first_lesson_count ELSE enrolled_count END), 0) AS rate
FROM weekly_funnel WHERE week BETWEEN :start_week AND :end_week;
-- 对两个窗口分别计算；12批次趋势额外 GROUP BY week，不平均周比例。

snippets.title: 累计与相邻分母不同
snippets.code:
SELECT SUM(enrolled_count) AS enrolled, SUM(first_lesson_count) AS first_lesson,
 SUM(first_lesson_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(enrolled_count), 0) AS first_lesson_conversion,
 SUM(week_one_active_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(first_lesson_count), 0) AS active_conversion,
 SUM(week_one_active_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(enrolled_count), 0) AS active_cumulative
FROM weekly_funnel WHERE week BETWEEN :start_week AND :end_week;
-- 其余相邻环节同理；人数损失是上一环节人数减下一环节人数。

snippets.title: 同一窗口内按课程或渠道重算
snippets.code:
SELECT CASE WHEN :segment_by = 'course_track' THEN course_track ELSE signup_source END AS segment_key,
 SUM(enrolled_count) AS enrolled, SUM(completed_count) AS completed,
 SUM(support_contact_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(enrolled_count), 0) AS support_per_100_enrolled
FROM weekly_funnel WHERE week BETWEEN :start_week AND :end_week
GROUP BY CASE WHEN :segment_by = 'course_track' THEN course_track ELSE signup_source END;
-- 主指标分母沿B2、相邻环节沿B3；另保留六阶段计数与报名占比，不把支持次数当漏斗人数。
